Class Dialogue

java.lang.Object
net.apexes.fetion4j.core.client.Activity
net.apexes.fetion4j.core.client.Dialogue
Direct Known Subclasses:
ChatDialogue, MainDialogue
public abstract class Dialogue extends Activity
Abstract base class for SIPC dialogues that can receive incoming messages. Extends Activity with a message-reception hook.
